meta.disclaimer: 本报告使用一个虚构示例实体，演示「贸易商自称生产商」时核验方法如何识别。示例实体不对应任何真实企业；所引公开证据（SABIC / Yansab / Petrokemya 等）均来自真实来源，用于对照说明「真生产商的证据长什么样」。报告中不含任何风险评分。

summary.headline: 自称「自有装置」的供应商，公开资料中查不到任何装置；建议暂停并索证
summary.text: 该示例供应商宣称在朱拜勒拥有自有 MEG 装置，并以「厂价直供」报价。核验发现：①没有任何官方或第三方来源显示其拥有生产设施；②其宣称的产能数字与沙特已公开装置均无法对应；③其提供的「工厂照片」为通用图库风格，无法定位到具体装置。对照真实沙特 MEG 生产商（Petrokemya / Yansab / Petro Rabigh / Jubail United），可核验生产商至少能提供装置所在工业区、集团归属与可查的产能披露。因此本例判定为「暂停推进」，并要求其以文件证明制造关系或明确改为经销商身份。
key_findings: 示例实体无可查的生产设施证据，其「自有工厂」主张仅存在于自述材料中（F04）。
真实沙特 MEG 生产商的证据形态：上市公司官网逐条披露 CR 号与工业许可证（E01）、集团产品页列明等级（E02）、官网披露具体产能数字（E16）。
「厂价直供」不等于制造能力：贸易商同样可以按厂价转售，区别在于是否有制造关系文件。
not_concluded: 不认定该示例主体从事欺诈；无法核实的部分一律标「未知」。
不认定其真实产能、库存或履约能力。

blocks.headline: 制造关系无法证实 · 交易层面不具备推进条件
blocks.text: 本例用于演示：当供应商自述与公开记录不符时，核验应当如何表述结论——只陈述「查到了什么」与「查不到什么」，不推断动机。

blocks.foot: 「查不到」与「不存在」不是一回事：前者是状态，后者是判断。本报告只记录状态。

blocks.text: 对照示例（真实可核生产商的做法）：SABIC 官网产品页可查到具体产品与等级（E02）；Yansab 在官网披露 CR 号与工业许可证号（E01）；Petro Rabigh 在官网写明 600 KTA 产能（E16）；Jubail United 的 700 kt/y 装置被行业媒体记录投料时间（E14）。一个真实生产商通常至少有其中一项。

rfi.title: Supplier Due-Diligence Enquiry — Monoethylene Glycol (MEG)
rfi.to: The Authorised Representative of Gulf Horizon Petrochemical Trading LLC
rfi.intro: We are conducting pre-qualification checks ahead of a prospective purchase of fibre-grade monoethylene glycol. Please answer each item in writing on company letterhead, signed by an officer with authority to bind the company. Please state clearly whether you are the producer of the goods or a reseller, and if a reseller, name the producing entity.

clauses.text: State whether you are the manufacturer of the goods offered or a reseller/trader, and support your answer with documents.
Confirm the full legal name, commercial registration (CR) number, registered address and legal form of the contracting entity, and attach the CR certificate.
If you operate a production plant, provide the plant name, city, licence number, product slate and nameplate capacity of the MEG line, together with the industrial licence.
Name the entity that will appear as producer on the COA and SDS for the goods supplied, and the entity that will appear as shipper on the bill of lading.
If you are a reseller, provide the producer's written authorisation for you to sell the goods in our market, or the producer's supply confirmation for this order.
Provide the TDS for the exact grade offered, including purity, diethylene glycol, colour and water content limits.
Provide a batch-level COA on the producer's letterhead for the offered grade, together with the batch number that will appear on the shipping documents.
Provide an official corporate e-mail address on your registered domain; replies from free webmail accounts cannot be treated as binding.
Provide a signed payment instruction on letterhead plus a bank confirmation letter from the receiving bank for the account to be credited.
Provide two recent bills of lading (redacted) for the same product evidencing your export performance and the shipper identity.
Provide the annual report or audited financial summary for the last financial year.
Provide an ultimate beneficial owner declaration and a group structure chart.
Confirm whether any sanctions, export controls or force majeure events currently affect your ability to supply, with dates.
Confirm the validity period of your offer, the delivery terms, and the governing law and dispute resolution venue proposed for the contract.

dos: 先问「你是生产商还是经销商」，再要文件；身份问题答不清，后面全是空转。
用公开装置清单/行业清单反向校验「自有产能」主张（本行业的可核生产商是可穷举的）。
把「查不到」写成状态，而不是写成「造假」。
donts: 不要因为对方说「factory price / factory direct」就认定是制造商。
不要把通用图库照片当作工厂证据。
不要在身份未定性前支付预付款。
